name: com.qoreid.sdk.modules.verifind4d.impl1_service.TrackingServiceActionReceiver
description: When QoreID requests a tracker restart, this Receiver starts the background monitoring service again so an active Verifind 4D check can continue.
disableEffect: QoreID cannot restart its Verifind 4D monitoring service through this Receiver, so an interrupted check will not resume this way.
